sentences.text: South Australia’s Independent Commission Against Corruption reviewed the effectiveness of the state’s whistleblower protections.
sentences.support: This report examines the effectiveness of South Australia’s whistleblower protection regime and recommends changes to enhance it.

sentences.text: The review examined eligibility for protection, remedies for retaliation, confidentiality, support, oversight and the clarity of the law.
sentences.support: Chapter 2: How should those who make disclosures be protected?

sentences.text: The Commission concluded that broader protection, better access to remedies and clearer laws would improve the regime.
sentences.support: The areas in which recommendations made in this report are perhaps most able to effect positive change

sentences.text: Its 61 recommendations included expanding protection, improving enforcement and establishing independent support for whistleblowers.
sentences.support: This report contains 61 recommendations to reform South Australia’s whistleblower protection regime.

findings.quote: An independent, and adequately resourced, whistleblower support authority could fill a significant gap in South Australia’s whistleblower protection regime.

notes: No separate executive summary or overview. Scope is taken from the introduction and chapter headings; conclusions and all 61 recommendations were read. The source pack’s document label is “here.”.
